done_when: The board shows the story as finished, with its outcome.
outcome: A salesperson prepares with a brief, keeps the customer's words, demos a prototype filled with their own kind of data by a five-step script, records reactions, and asks for sign-off only after the strict review passes

findings.body: The outcome claims a customer-shaped demo, but Done-when item 2 in plans/FORGE-AHA-1.md:45-51 also requires the Forge skill to tell the agent to build the demo-data loader in the prototype’s first version and use `Words they use` for screen labels. The prototype instructions in src/forge/templates/skill.md:119-136 say neither. The loader is mentioned in the stack convention, but that does not complete the skill requirement. Add the instruction before recording the story as finished.
findings.title: Story marked done before the first-version demo instructions are complete

findings.body: Done-when item 3 in plans/FORGE-AHA-1.md:52-54 requires the skill to tell salespeople to click an element, write what is wrong, and paste the toolbar output to the agent. The frontend convention describes that workflow at src/forge/templates/conventions/frontend.md:54-55, but the skill’s prototype and demo instructions at src/forge/templates/skill.md:119-153 omit it. Marking the whole story done hides this unfinished customer-facing handoff.
findings.title: Story marked done without the salesperson feedback instructions

findings.body: This fix’s Done-when is a board-visible result, but its sole commit message has no `Functional check:` paragraph or recorded observation from running `forge board` against this changed story. The existing command test in tests/test_board.py:134-197 checks a generic story, not this record. Run the real board command and record that FORGE-AHA-1 appears finished with the stated outcome.
findings.title: Not done: functional check

why: Record that Forge covers building and sign-off records, but almost nothing the customer sees: no pre-meeting brief, no recap in their words, no realistic demo data, no demo script, no record of their reactions, and new projects are sent to a removed /office-hours step is finished, and what it achieved.
